title: 21 Meetings for a Corporate Insurance Brokerage
challenge: A corporate insurance brokerage wanted to expand its relationships with businesses seeking employee benefits and commercial risk coverage.
solution: Myntmore built targeted outreach campaigns to HR heads, CFOs and business owners. Messaging focused on risk-planning discussions, benefit structures and common coverage challenges rather than product-led pitches.
results: 7 requests for policy or coverage reviews.
Higher engagement with relevant business stakeholders.
